added_lines: our lady of the rosary parish, limerick our church from 1950 our parish from 1964 parish newsletter 25 october 2026 30th sunday in ordinary time our housebound parishioners are you one of our housebound parishioners reading this online? do you miss coming to mass because you are confined at home? is there a member of your family housebound and only able to get mass online? we are trying to expand the service of bringing the holy eucharist to those of our parishioners who are confined to their homes. please let us have names and contact details for anyone who would appreciate regular visits from a minister of the eucharist. hospitality on wednesdays we will have the usual gathering for tea / coffee / chat in the parish centre after 10:00am mass on wednesday. please come along to share the hospitality. report from the parish council the parish pastoral council met on 13 october. there was a discussion on the recent diocesan assembly. canon des was very pleased and impressed with the students from ard scoil rís who attended the beginning of the year school mass, in particular the student eucharistic ministers, and he hopes that these pupils may join our ministers of the eucharist team. there was a discussion on establishing a youth parish pastoral council for students aged 14 – 18. parking on the road during the week is a problem as the students from asr, who drive themselves to school, are taking up parking spaces. many elderly parishioners are unable to come to daily mass as they have nowhere to park. it was decided to approach the principal of the school in an attempt to come up with some solution. there was also a reference to the position of the tabernacle and replacing some of the ciboria . irish synodal pathway as the irish synodal pathway moves towards implementation, the working document for the national synodal assembly, which took place on 17 october, is available at
